rounds.prompt: Which friction type is the WEAKEST?
rounds.explain: Order: static > sliding > rolling. Rolling is weakest.

rounds.prompt: A lubricant like oil is used to…
rounds.explain: Oil fills the bumps so surfaces glide, reducing friction.
